audit_method: Same-agent exact comparison against the frozen source, adjacent prose, declared notation, logical macro grammar and glossary token syntax within that revision. No claim about current upstream master is made.

corrections.finding: The inner sorted universal quantifier lacks the opening square bracket required by the logical macro.
corrections.handling: Restored the bracketed argument of the inner quantifier and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The surrounding quantifier and every other use of the same macro pass the bound variable in a square-bracket argument.

corrections.finding: The successor-injectivity axiom uses an undeclared s notation although the language has just declared prime as its successor symbol.
corrections.handling: Used the declared prime successor notation consistently and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding language declaration and every neighboring arithmetic axiom use the prime symbol for successor.

corrections.finding: Noun glossary markup is embedded inside the English verb formulated, leaving an invalid tokenized inflection.
corrections.handling: Translated the coherent verb without noun glossary markup and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The clause requires the English verb formulated; the glossary token denotes the mathematical noun formula and cannot carry the suffix ted.

corrections.finding: The explanatory sentence assigns x type sigma, contrary to the preceding formation clause where x has type tau and the abstraction has type tau to sigma.
corrections.handling: Restored tau as the bound variable's type and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: Formation item (6) explicitly gives x type tau and lambda x.s type tau to sigma.

corrections.finding: The glossary markup for formulas contains a stray caret and therefore does not match the project's token syntax.
corrections.handling: Restored the standard plural formula token and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The same term is marked with the standard !!{formula} token throughout the surrounding chapters.

corrections.finding: Noun glossary markup is embedded inside two English verb forms, producing invalid tokenized inflections rather than the intended verbs.
corrections.handling: Translated both coherent verb uses without noun glossary markup and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: Both clauses require the English verb structure; the glossary token denotes the mathematical noun and cannot carry English inflection.
